data.name: Robot Roller-Derby Disco Dodgeball
data.detailed_description:
Steam Workshop

Submit items to the game and earn sales revenue!


About the Game

Disco Dodgeball combines the physics-based projectile combat of dodgeball with flowing skateboard-style movement to create a fast-paced, skillful arena shooter unlike any other.

Highlights:

  • Dodge, deflect, and catch enemy shots like real dodgeball.

  • Perform ridiculous aerial stunt shots like 360 helicopters and mid-air catches to rack up big points.

  • Arenas are stuffed with neon glowing lights that pulse and animate in time with the music - either the built-in soundtrack, or ANY web browser or media player audio.

  • Tons of different game modes & solo/co-op challenges to test your skills and teamwork - like Hoops, Grand Prix racing, Capture the Cube, and of course classic Elimination.

  • Computer-controlled opponents available in singleplayer and online multiplayer with multiple difficulty options. (Hard bots are deadly smart & accurate, and will give you a serious challenge.)

  • Multiplayer uses Steam Networking for optimal connection speeds

  • Split-screen Local Multiplayer PvP and co-op challenges with up to 4 players

  • Cosmetic hats, robot bodies, heads, wheels, decals, sunglasses, moustaches, and ball FX that can be crafted or earned from random in-game drops

  • Powerups like Jetpacks, Huge Dodgeballs, Laser Balls, and Boomerang Balls. Pick them up randomly or enable as permanent arena modifiers.

Steam Workshop

  • Design your own dance club battle arenas with the built-in level editor.

  • Create custom game modes with in-game rule editor.

  • Share your creations on the Steam Workshop, or download hundreds of player-created entries on the Steam Workshop.

  • Use any of these creations in singleplayer or online multiplayer

Singleplayer Content

Don't want to play online? There's still tons to do.

  • Arcade mode: It's you vs waves of bots & bosses. Collect cash and upgrade yourself with super-powered perks that give you extra shields, slow down time, or knock out opponents with EMP blasts.

  • Career mode: Create your own custom dodgeball team of computer teammates and lead them through the leagues on your way to the championship. Play alongside them and earn cash for trick shots and objective completions, then use that cash to upgrade yourself, train your teammates, or recruit free agents. Each match has high stakes as you fight to reach the top your league and get promoted to the more exclusive leagues above you.

  • Leaderboard-based solo score challenges to defeat tons of enemy bots in different modes.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: This game contains lots of flashing lights. You can enable photosensitive mode in options / video. This will disable lasers, bright explosions and other lights that pulse to the beat of the music.

data.short_description: A futuresport FPS where you race around a skate park / dance club and nail each other with dodgeball trick shots
data.reviews:
“It's a great idea well executed...so many satisfying moments...you should probably think about buying it if you're into arena shooters - frankly, it's a damn good one.”
TotalBiscuit

“Disco Dodgeball feels like an utter revelation, a lightning bolt aimed to shock FPS developers from their creative slumber”
9/10 – IndieHaven

“It's as amazing as you would expect.”
Wired
